claim_1.claim: Transcription profiling by array analysis of peripheral blood RNA from a discovery cohort of 119 healthy adult male volunteers and a validation cohort of 128 healthy adult female volunteers, measured before vaccination (day 0) and on days 1, 3, and 14 after vaccination, showed 78 genes with evidence of both a transcriptional response to the vaccine and significant genetic regulation of expression in both cohorts.

sources.quote: A majority of these (467 SNP-transcript pairs, corresponding to 78 unique genes) would pass equally stringent thresholds in both cohorts (genotype effect p<5 × 10−8, day effect p<0.01).
We immunized an ethnically homogeneous group of 119 healthy adult male volunteers with licensed trivalent influenza vaccine.
We also measured global transcript abundance in peripheral blood RNA specimens before and at three time points (days 1, 3, and 14) after vaccination.
An identical study was then carried out with an independent validation cohort of 128 ethnically homogeneous healthy adult female volunteers.

comparison.finding: 78 genes showed evidence of both a transcriptional response to the vaccine and significant genetic regulation of expression in both cohorts at day 0
78 genes showed evidence of both a transcriptional response to the vaccine and significant genetic regulation of expression in both cohorts at day 1
78 genes showed evidence of both a transcriptional response to the vaccine and significant genetic regulation of expression in both cohorts at day 3
78 genes showed evidence of both a transcriptional response to the vaccine and significant genetic regulation of expression in both cohorts at day 14

claim_2.claim: Transcription profiling by array analysis of peripheral blood RNA from the male and female cohorts showed that at some loci the magnitude of the genetic effect on expression increased after vaccination, with validated examples including NECAB2 and a top 1% delta-Rg2 set of 146 SNP-transcript pairs in both cohorts, compared to pre-vaccination baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: This analysis revealed multiple loci at which the genetic effect was either enhanced or only apparent after the experimental perturbation.
An example is presented in Figure 2A, which displays local Manhattan plots for the NECAB2 locus before and 3 days after vaccination in both cohorts.

To select a conservative set of candidate loci based on this property for further analysis, we identified the SNP-transcript pairs that were in the top 1% of the delta-Rg2 distribution and also showed evidence of a strong cis-acting eQTL (genotype effect p<5 × 10−8), in both cohorts. Data for the resulting set of 146 SNP-transcript pairs, including Rg2 values, are provided in Table 2

comparison.finding: male and female cohorts were both assessed at pre-vaccination baseline for genetic effects on expression

in both male and female cohorts after vaccination at day 3, the magnitude of the genetic effect on expression increased at some loci, with validated examples including NECAB2 and a top 1% delta-Rg2 set of 146 SNP-transcript pairs

claim_3.claim: Transcription profiling by array analysis of peripheral blood RNA from the combined male and female cohorts showed that 301 transcripts correlated with the magnitude of the antibody response to influenza vaccination, including 218 positive and 83 negative correlations.

sources.quote: In a combined analysis of the two cohorts in the present study, 301 transcripts were found to correlate with the magnitude of the antibody response (Figure 4).

A total of 301 genes showed evidence of significant correlation between gene expression and the antibody response to the vaccine in both cohorts. Of these, 218 showed evidence of positive correlation and 83 of negative correlation.

claim_4.claim: Hemagglutination Inhibition analysis of serum from 119 healthy adult male volunteers and 128 healthy adult female volunteers, measured before vaccination (day 0) and on days 14 and 28 after vaccination, showed vaccine antibody responses that were integrated with neutralizing titers into a Titer Response Index to quantify overall vaccine responsiveness.

sources.quote: Type-specific antibody measurements (H1N1, H3N2, and FluB) were made in serum samples before and at two time points (days 14 and 28) after vaccination.
HAI and neutralizing antibody titers were measured for each viral antigen included in the vaccine.

For each individual, we computed a Titer Response Index (TRI), as previously described (Bucasas et al., 2011). The TRI characterizes the magnitude of an individual’s antibody rise accounting for their pre-vaccination titer and integrating the responses across the three vaccine components to provide an overall measure of vaccine responsiveness.

claim_5.claim: Neutralizing Antibody Titer Assay analysis of serum from 119 healthy adult male volunteers and 128 healthy adult female volunteers, measured before vaccination (day 0) and on days 14 and 28 after vaccination, showed vaccine antibody responses that were integrated with hemagglutination inhibition titers into a Titer Response Index to quantify overall vaccine responsiveness.

sources.quote: HAI and neutralizing antibody titers were measured for each viral antigen included in the vaccine.

For each individual, we computed a Titer Response Index (TRI), as previously described (Bucasas et al., 2011). The TRI characterizes the magnitude of an individual’s antibody rise accounting for their pre-vaccination titer and integrating the responses across the three vaccine components to provide an overall measure of vaccine responsiveness.
Type-specific antibody measurements (H1N1, H3N2, and FluB) were made in serum samples before and at two time points (days 14 and 28) after vaccination.

claim_6.claim: Genome-wide SNP genotyping analysis of peripheral blood DNA from the male and female cohorts showed 137 eQTL SNP-transcript pairs from 20 loci with evidence of association with the antibody response to vaccination compared with the empirical background SNP distribution.

sources.quote: We determined genetic associations to the antibody response using 137 eQTL SNPs from these 20 loci.
The empirical quantile-quantile plot of the result SNPs shows significant deviation from the empirical distribution of the entire data set (background SNPs, in blue).
